verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships its own delegation workflow. Once the user says "go", it dispatches engineering tasks to subagents and reviews them with its own code-reviewer agent, and the agent can work autonomously for hours. However, the AI assistant itself is the host harness (Claude Code, Codex and others), not a model built into Superpowers, so the delegation runs through an external agent. Missing for 10: a self-contained built-in assistant independent of the host harness, and independent hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: once you say "go", it launches a *subagent-driven-development* process, having agents work through each engineering task
It's not uncommon for your agent to work autonomously for a couple hours at a time
The framework includes a code-reviewer agent that evaluates implementations against plans, coding standards, and architectural principles.
it dispatches tasks one by one to subagents to implement and then code reviews each task before continuing.
